semantics.essential: Estimated upcoming essential expenses (ballpark OK) with due dates and funding account. Forward-looking plan — not a record of what already spent.
semantics.personal: Alias for Essential (legacy tab title). Estimated upcoming essential expenses — not actual spend.
semantics.fleet: Auto fleet expenses (loans, insurance, ops). Expense burn; combined with Essential for upcoming bills and pay-from pressure.
semantics.collateral: Collateral / capital investments. Not expense burn.
semantics.productive_discretionary: Capital outlay that grows productive asset base. Quantitative targets. Priority over consumer wishlist. Not expense burn.
semantics.consumer_discretionary: Consumer goods / personal wishlist (qualitative). Lower priority. Not expense burn and not ops expansion capital targets.
semantics.discretionary: Alias for Productive Discretionary (legacy name). Capital outlay that grows productive asset base — not expense burn.
semantics.actual_spend: YNAB (and brokers) own realized transactions; do not double-count with Essential/Fleet.

Essential.label: Essential
Essential.description: Estimated upcoming essential expenses (ballpark OK) with due dates and funding account. Forward-looking plan — not actual spend.

Fleet.label: Fleet
Fleet.description: Auto fleet expenses (loans, insurance, wash, repairs). Included in upcoming expense burn with Essential.

Collateral.label: Collateral
Collateral.description: Collateral / productive capital investments. Not expense burn. Separate from recurring Essential/Fleet obligations.

Productive Discretionary.label: Productive Discretionary
Productive Discretionary.description: Capital outlay that grows productive asset base (quantitative). Priority over Consumer Discretionary. Fund from collateralized margin.

Consumer Discretionary.label: Consumer Discretionary
Consumer Discretionary.description: Consumer goods / personal wishlist (qualitative). Lower priority than Productive Discretionary. Not expense burn.

Personal.label: Essential
Personal.description: Estimated upcoming essential expenses (ballpark OK) with due dates and funding account. Forward-looking plan — not actual spend.

Discretionary.label: Productive Discretionary
Discretionary.description: Capital outlay that grows productive asset base (quantitative). Priority over Consumer Discretionary. Fund from collateralized margin.

notes: Essential = estimated essential bills by pay-from account (legacy tab: Personal). Fleet = auto fleet expenses (included in burn). Collateral = collateral/capital investments (not burn). Productive Discretionary = capital outlay growing productive assets (priority; margin-funded). Consumer Discretionary = wishlist / consumer goods (lower priority). Burn = Essential + Fleet only. Actual spend = YNAB.
